engineer_hours_per_manual_investigation.why: A practicing fab data scientist told us false-alarm holds are usually cleared in 2 to 3 hours.

engineer_hours_per_review.why: About 10 minutes to read a disposition with cited evidence and approve or reject it (our estimate).

lot_hours_per_needless_hold.why: A needlessly held lot waits as long as the investigation that clears it.

lots_at_risk_per_missed_fault.why: In the simulator about half of lots are sampled, so a missed chamber fault runs about two more lots before the next measured wafer can catch it.
